headline: 32 arrested over Awami League procession in Gulshan
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police have detained leaders and activists of the banned party for allegedly participating in a procession in the capital's Gulshan area.
details: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) have arrested 32 leaders and activists of the Awami League and its associate bodies for allegedly taking part in a procession in Gulshan.
The arrests were made in connection with a case filed at the Gulshan Police Station under the Anti-Terrorism Act.
The government banned all activities of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations on May 11 last year, following allegations of killings and crimes against humanity during the July uprising.
DMP Additional Deputy Commissioner (Media) Niaz Mehedi and Deputy Commissioner (Media) Akter Hossain confirmed the arrests.
caption:
32 Awami League leaders and activists arrested in Gulshan.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) have arrested 32 leaders and activists of the Awami League and its associate bodies for allegedly taking part in a procession in Gulshan.

The arrests were made in connection with a case filed at the Gulshan Police Station under the Anti-Terrorism Act.

The government banned all activities of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations on May 11 last year, following allegations of killings and crimes against humanity during the July uprising.

DMP Additional Deputy Commissioner (Media) Niaz Mehedi and Deputy Commissioner (Media) Akter Hossain confirmed the arrests.

headline_marked: 6 body parts of unknown man [[recovered from 3 cartons]] in Faridpur
headline: 6 body parts of unknown man recovered from 3 cartons in Faridpur
summary: Police found the remains of a man aged 45-50 years old abandoned by the side of the Dhaka-Khulna highway in Madhukhali.
details: Police recovered the severed body parts of an unidentified man from three cartons found by the side of the Dhaka-Khulna highway in Madhukhali, Faridpur.
The remains, consisting of six separate pieces, were discovered on Saturday afternoon in the Boalia area of Raipur Union.
Passersby noticed the cartons and became suspicious when a strong foul smell began to emanate from them, prompting them to alert the local police.
Madhukhali police arrived at the scene and seized the cartons, upon opening which they found the body parts of a man estimated to be between 45 and 50 years old.
Assistant Superintendent of Police (Madhukhali Circle) Masuduzzaman stated that the body has been sent to Faridpur Medical College Hospital for an autopsy.
Once the identity of the deceased is established through the autopsy and investigation, the body will be transferred to Anjuman Mofidul Islam for burial according to regulations.
caption:
Body parts of an unidentified man found in 3 cartons by a highway in Faridpur.

Police recovered the severed body parts of an unidentified man from three cartons found by the side of the Dhaka-Khulna highway in Madhukhali, Faridpur.

The remains, consisting of six separate pieces, were discovered on Saturday afternoon in the Boalia area of Raipur Union.

Passersby noticed the cartons and became suspicious when a strong foul smell began to emanate from them, prompting them to alert the local police.

Madhukhali police arrived at the scene and seized the cartons, upon opening which they found the body parts of a man estimated to be between 45 and 50 years old.

Assistant Superintendent of Police (Madhukhali Circle) Masuduzzaman stated that the body has been sent to Faridpur Medical College Hospital for an autopsy.

Once the identity of the deceased is established through the autopsy and investigation, the body will be transferred to Anjuman Mofidul Islam for burial according to regulations.
